from numpy.fft import fft2, ifft2, fftfreq

    ky = 2 * np.pi * fftfreq(Ny, d=dy)

        mu = (beta / 2.0) * (dg_dc * A_g + g * A_dc) - h * dg_dc
        
        mu_batch[b] = mu

    return mu_batch
